about: What FXM's desktop and Android apps trust for signed updates (the YouTube config and resolver module): the Ed25519 public keys whose signatures they accept, and in "revoked" the versions they refuse even when validly signed, per artifact kind, e.g. {"youtube-module": [4]}. The first key signs updates; the second is its offline backup, used only if the signing key leaks or is lost (both created with scripts/make-signing-key.sh on 2026-10-26). Never put a private key here.
